page.title: Desk
page.purpose: Which optional scenarios are reachable, what reads unknown because of them, Web Console access in plain words, the courier's real state, automatic launch availability, the confirmed launch and courier self-tests, and the theme.

states.description: Capabilities and sources with their status.
An optional scenario is down; the values it feeds are listed.
The API cannot be reached or refused the read; the page names which and offers retry, and nothing else on the page pretends to know.
The page announces that it is reading the research home; nothing is shown as known until it is.
No optional scenario is configured: each source reads not configured and the desk still works from files.
A refresh failed after a good read: the earlier read stays on screen under a 'Not current' notice with its time and the reason.
